instructions_en: Listen to the discussion. For each statement, decide whether the man, the woman, or both express the opinion.
instructions_vi: Nghe cuộc thảo luận. Với mỗi nhận định, chọn người đàn ông, người phụ nữ hoặc cả hai.

audio.transcript: Woman: I like the new flexible working policy. Being able to work at home twice a week saves me a lot of travel time. Man: The flexibility is useful, but I still prefer coming into the office because it is easier to ask colleagues quick questions. Woman: That is true. Team communication can be harder online, especially for new staff. Man: And I think managers should make sure remote workers receive the same training opportunities. Woman: Absolutely. Working from home should not reduce anyone's chance to develop.
